description: Single source-of-truth synthetic fixture for headline planning numbers used across this demo (annual budget, forecast new policy sales, cost per new policy sale, monthly budget weights, channel taxonomy). All figures here are clearly-labelled illustrative placeholders, not Admiral performance data - see brief section 5.

annual_summary.note: cost_per_new_policy_sale_gbp = total_media_budget_gbp / forecast_new_policy_sales. forecast_quote_starts = forecast_new_policy_sales / (quote_to_policy_conversion_pct / 100). Media budget excludes PCW distribution spend, which is measured separately - see distribution_summary.

monthly_budget_weights_note: March and September are illustrative UK plate-change peaks (1 March / 1 September registration changes are a real public UK motoring fact) - the specific weight values are a synthetic planning assumption for this demo, not evidence of Admiral's actual phasing.

owned_activation.label: Owned activation
owned_activation.description: CRM, email, app, website and SEO/content - shown separately from paid media unless paid activation cost is explicitly in scope. Direct Mail is mapped here as the closest addressable/CRM-adjacent channel in this demo's existing taxonomy; it is not one of section 4's named examples.

distribution.label: Distribution
distribution.description: Price-comparison websites and approved affiliates. Measured on ranking, quote share and sale conversion - kept separate from impression-based media budget and the media-mix chart.

distribution_summary.note: Price-comparison websites are a distribution channel, not impression-based media - reported separately from the media budget/mix above and measured on ranking, quote share and sale conversion.
